Synthetic local-HTTP tests only; live conformance is owner opt in and unproven.

m2.credentials.note: M2.2 OS-keyring credential boundary: macOS/Apple and Linux secret-service native backends enforced, no plaintext or in-memory fallback, zeroized values, no secret returned to the renderer. The isolated keyring conformance test is owner opt in (PROJECTOS_TEST_KEYRING=1) and unproven in this environment.
